restaurantName: The Tea Lounge at The Clermont Victoria
bio: The Clermont Victoria Hotel is one of London's great railway hotels with period features and ambience reflecting its unique Victorian heritage. First opened in 1861, the hotel is adjacent to Victoria mainline railway station and within easy walking distance of many of London's famous landmarks, such as Buckingham Palace and the Houses of Parliament.  The Tea Lounge is a perfect getaway from the hustle and bustle of the platform outside. Light, airy and a relaxing haven, just steps away from our grand lobby and Victoria Station. The Tea Lounge is a destination of its own. Take a seat in a cosy corner and enjoy the delights of a classic afternoon tea with friends or maybe add a little sparkle with a glass or two of bubbles.  The teas are supplied by family owned London company: BIRCHALL was established 1872, over 140 years ago. Today, they are one of the largest exporters of black teas from East Africa in the world. Tea Lounge at The Clermont Victoria Hotel is now offering over nine different loose leaf teas that goes perfectly with Afternoon Tea.
pageTitle: The Tea Lounge at The Clermont Victoria
